protectedReasoning: Ten concurrent requests share at most two extra attempts in each fixed 100-unit logical window. Each request has one initial attempt and at most one retry. Only retryable errors may retry.

The visible caller configuration supplies the same RetryBudget(clock, allowance2, window100) instance to all ten calls, with no outer retry owner. The service forwards that instance and the helper consumes it before each extra attempt. Protection is conditional on this supplied wiring; the optional helper parameter alone proves no aggregate bound.
Protection applies to this declared path and schedule, not arbitrary production workloads.
